title: 'Nobody was going to beat the 10th pick:' How the Bengals wooed the Giants into trading vet Dexter Lawrence

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: 'Nobody was going to beat the 10th pick:' How the Bengals wooed the Giants into trading vet Dexter Lawrence
sources.description: Lawrence informed the Giants he wanted a new deal or trade, the Giants didn't want to let him go -- until the price was right.
